item.title: Audio Support
item.description: Audio Support#aibox can enable audio support for voice-capable tools. Audio is bridged from the container to the host via PulseAudio over TCP, and the required container packages live in the optional audio-voice addon. item.title: File Preview
item.description: File Preview#aibox containers ship with Yazi preview configuration and can install TUI-native preview tools for raster images, vector graphics, PDF, archives, and video through optional addons. Several formats also support watch-mode preview, where the rendered output updates automatically whenever the source file changes.
